important_decisions.rationale: In compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py lines 618-628, post_process_docx_zip checked 'if bidi is not None: tblPr.remove(bidi) else: bidi = ET.Element(...)'. When bidi already existed in tblPr (as was true for preamble tables 1-14 copied from Chapter_4_Preamble_Source.docx), the code removed the element but bypassed the else branch, preserving the original ElementTree object and its attributes (w:val='1'). When tblPr.insert(tblW_idx, bidi) executed, the contaminated element with w:val='1' was re-inserted into Table 2 (Table 4-2).

alternatives_considered.reason: Developer assumed removing and re-inserting without clearing attributes would satisfy the empty element requirement, inadvertently preserving w:val='1'.
All bidiVisual elements must strictly have zero attributes to satisfy OnOffOnlyType across desktop GUI editors.

important_decisions.rationale: Compiler script did not verify whether the deliverable was currently open in a desktop office suite (e.g. ONLYOFFICE holding .~lock.Chapter_4_Results.docx#). When compiling in-place while ONLYOFFICE was actively open, the desktop application did not hot-reload disk modifications, leaving the user with a stale view.

alternatives_considered.reason: Alert user or pause compilation if a lockfile indicates an open Word/ONLYOFFICE GUI session.

evidence_summary.auditor_blindspot: academic_chapter_auditor checked existence of bidiVisual and sequence relative to tblW, but failed to detect that Table 2 (Table 4-2) still carried w:val='1' on the XML element.

failed_checks: CHK-ONLYOFFICE-TABLE-HANDLE-ALIGNMENT: Table move handle rendered on top-left instead of top-right.
CHK-ONLYOFFICE-COLUMN-ORDER-LTR: Column 1 ('وضعیت') rendered on far left, Column 2 ('فراوانی') in middle, Column 3 ('درصد') on far right.
CHK-OPENXML-BIDIVISUAL-ONOFFONLY-VIOLATION: Table 4-2 retained <w:bidiVisual w:val='1'/> causing ONLYOFFICE parser to discard table-level RTL orientation.
